taiwan_aviation.headline: 美國聯邦航空總署一度暫停部分飛往芝加哥奧黑爾機場的航班起飛 GE Aerospace國防部門執行長將於2027年首季離任
taiwan_aviation.summary: 美國聯邦航空總署因芝加哥近場航空管制人力不足，11月23日要求部分飛往奧黑爾機場的航班留在出發地，當地中午左右解除限制。另，GE Aerospace國防部門執行長將於2027年首季離任，工程副總裁將立即代理。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: FAA briefly halts some Chicago O’Hare-bound departures; GE Aerospace defense chief to leave in first quarter of 2027
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: The U.S. Federal Aviation Administration held some Chicago O’Hare-bound flights at their departure airports on November 23 because of air traffic control staffing shortages, lifting the restriction around noon local time. Separately, GE Aerospace’s defense chief will leave in the first quarter of 2027, and the engineering vice president will immediately take over as interim chief.

new_information: On November 23, 2026, GE Aerospace said Amy Gowder would depart in the first quarter of 2027.
The president and CEO of GE Aerospace Defense and Systems is stepping down from her role in 2027.
Darin DiTommaso, vice president of engineering for Defense and Systems, will immediately assume the role of interim president and CEO.
GE Aerospace is searching for a permanent replacement.
Gowder joined GE Aerospace as CEO of its defense unit in April 2022.
DiTommaso led GE Aerospace’s performance and preliminary design teams across several engine programs, including GEnx and LEAP.

international_aviation.headline: 高雄國際機場氣候韌性案例納入報告 並於聯合國氣候大會發表
international_aviation.summary: 民航局表示，高雄國際機場的防災韌性案例獲國際永續基礎設施聯盟收錄於交通氣候韌性報告，並在聯合國氣候大會發表。機場強化排水滯洪及防水抗風，2024年強颱期間航廈與跑道未淹水；防災體系另獲國際機場協會綠色機場評比亞太及中東地區氣候變遷調適白金獎。
international_aviation.headline_en: Kaohsiung International Airport resilience case included in report and presented at UN climate conference
international_aviation.summary_en: Taiwan’s Civil Aeronautics Administration said Kaohsiung International Airport’s resilience case was included in a transport-focused climate resilience report by the International Coalition for Sustainable Infrastructure and presented at a UN climate conference. The airport strengthened drainage, flood retention, waterproofing and wind resistance; its terminal and runway did not flood during a strong typhoon in 2024. Its disaster response system also received an Airports Council International green airport assessment’s platinum award for climate change adaptation in the Asia-Pacific and Middle East region.

international_aviation.headline: 廈門航空簽約採購50架波音737 MAX 8 交易待核准 預計2031至2034年分批交付
international_aviation.summary: 中國南方航空11月24日公告，其持股55%的廈門航空已與波音簽約購買50架737 MAX 8，預計2031至2034年分批交付。飛機目錄價合計約74億美元，優惠後成交價未公布；交易仍須中國主管機關核准，並交由南航股東會審議。南航表示，廈門航空將藉遷往廈門翔安國際機場發展福建樞紐。
international_aviation.headline_en: Xiamen Airlines signs for 50 Boeing 737 MAX 8 jets pending approval, with deliveries planned for 2031 to 2034
international_aviation.summary_en: China Southern Airlines said on November 24 that Xiamen Airlines, in which it holds a 55% stake, has signed an agreement with Boeing to buy 50 737 MAX 8 jets for delivery in stages from 2031 to 2034. Their combined list price is about $7.4 billion, but the discounted purchase price was not disclosed. The transaction still requires approval from Chinese authorities and review by China Southern’s shareholders. China Southern said Xiamen Airlines plans to develop its Fujian hub network as it relocates operations to Xiamen Xiang’an International Airport.
